subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the repository accept these grouped third-party action revisions across secret-bearing, write-enabled, release, and security workflows after provenance and current-head validation?
rationale: The patch is mechanically correct, but accepting new executable supply-chain revisions in privileged workflows is an ownership and security-boundary decision that automated review cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve after provenance review
options.body: Verify each commit pin against its stated upstream release, rebase, require security-owner approval, and land the group when representative checks pass.

options.title: Split privileged updates
options.body: Separate Codex, token, CodeQL, and Docker publishing action pins into smaller PRs if their upstream changes cannot be reviewed confidently as one group.

recommendation.title: Approve after provenance review
recommendation.body: Verify each commit pin against its stated upstream release, rebase, require security-owner approval, and land the group when representative checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest merged history across action-version modernization and the affected agent and release workflows.
